invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null HashMap, so result is never null.
The local variable assigned is a HashMap, so result should always be a HashMap instance.
At most one key/value pair may be added to the map, so the size is either 0 or 1.
The PLAN_STRATEGY_SORT_COLUMNS.key() is only put if clustering sort columns is non-null and non-empty.
